description: This file defines an AzureBlobStorageLogger class that handles logging functionality by uploading logs to Azure Blob Storage using both SDK-based and REST API methods. It includes methods for batch processing logs, managing Azure authentication tokens, creating and appending to files in Azure Data Lake Storage, and handling credential refreshes.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageLogger
classes.description: A logger class that uploads logs to Azure Blob Storage, supporting token-based authentication and SDK-based file upload methods.

methods.name: __init__( self, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the logger, sets up environment variables, starts periodic flushing, and prepares internal state.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs successful events asynchronously by adding payloads to a queue.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs failure events asynchronously by adding payloads to a queue.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends accumulated logs in the queue to Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: async_upload_payload_to_azure_blob_storage( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Uploads a single payload to Azure Blob Storage using a multi-step process.

methods.name: _create_file(self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str)
methods.description: Creates a file resource in Azure Data Lake Storage.

methods.name: _append_data( self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str, json_payload: str )
methods.description: Appends data to an existing file in Azure Data Lake Storage.

methods.name: _flush_data(self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str, position: int)
methods.description: Flushes appended data to finalize the file in Azure Data Lake Storage.

methods.name: set_valid_azure_ad_token(self)
methods.description: Ensures the Azure AD token is valid, refreshing it if necessary.

methods.name: str get_azure_ad_token_from_azure_storage( self, tenant_id: Optional[str], client_id: Optional[str], client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Obtains a new Azure AD token from the environment variables and token provider.

methods.name: _azure_ad_token_is_expired(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the current Azure AD token is expired or close to expiry.

methods.name: _premium_user_check(self)
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has premium access, raises error if not.

methods.name: get_service_client(self)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Azure Data Lake Storage service client.

methods.name: upload_to_azure_data_lake_with_azure_account_key( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Uploads payload data directly to Azure Data Lake Storage using the SDK when account key is available.
